## Environment / 环境

Skill version, host version, model, date, and available tools / 技能版本、宿主版本、模型、日期、可用工具：

## Original input / 原始输入

Include the question, reviewed text, and relevant evidence. Remove credentials and private or unpublishable material. / 附问题、被审文本和相关依据，删除密钥及无权公开的材料。

## Actual output / 实际输出

Include the total, rationale, and subsequent actions if testing a checkpoint. / 附总分、依据；阶段纠错请附后续行动。

## Expected judgment and evidence / 期望判断与依据

Which claim or inference was misjudged? What counterexample, source, or calculation supports your assessment? If uncertain, describe the ambiguity. / 哪条推断被误判？请给可核查的反例、来源或计算；不确定时说明争议。
